mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals improving manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO exceeds 12-month MA by 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in CPI inflation above 2% for three months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL < 2% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL < 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate (implied by PAYEMS and UNRATE) above 62.5% for three months signals broader labor market engagement, which increases aggregate demand and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when implied participation rate exceeds 62.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% for two months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when HOUST exceeds 12-month MA by 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for three months signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below 12-month MA by 3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
